# anysearch Search API Provider Matrix

Offerings: 31. Native API facts and existing anysearch SDK mappings; comparison-only entries have no adapter.

## Anthropic Web Search
- Docs: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool
- Env: Not integrated
- Domain filters: full
- Country: full
- Language: unknown
- Date range: unknown
- Safe search: unknown
- Mode: Basic web search, Dynamic filtering
- Pricing / 1K: $10 / 1K searches + model token charges
- Free tier limits: No recurring free allowance verified
- Latency by tier: No current comparable measurement verified
- AI Answer: full
- Full text: partial
- Summary: not_applicable
- Highlights: partial
- News: partial
- Product category: Model-hosted grounding
- Availability: Available
- Native API overview: Claude server-side web search tool; not standalone raw search. Generated answers and search-result processing add model costs.
- anysearch SDK: Comparison only — no adapter
- Evidence checked: 2026-10-21
- Limits / billing caveats: Model/tool limits vary; tool use requires compatible model
- Capability basis: Native API — reviewed

- Full text: none
- Summary: none
- Highlights: none

- Product category: Third-party SERP service

- Capability basis: Existing SDK mappings
